title: Iatridis 1997a non-degenerate NP dynamic shear modulus |G*| vs frequency

quantity.name: |G*| dynamic shear modulus
quantity.definition: magnitude of complex shear modulus, torsional shear, 0.01 rad amplitude, 10% compressive offset

source.authors: Iatridis JC, Setton LA, Weidenbaum M, Mow VC
source.sample: 13 cylindrical NP samples (8 mm diameter, 1.44+-0.39 mm thick) from 8 spines, grade I discs (L2-L3 n=1, L3-L4 n=6, L4-L5 n=1 as printed)

protocol.summary: Frozen NP cylinders (8 mm trephine, sledge microtome), tested in a humidity chamber in torsional shear (Rheometrics RMS-800, parallel plates) at 10% compressive offset strain; dynamic frequency sweep at shear strain amplitude 0.01 rad, 1-100 rad/s; then fast-ramp (0.025 s) stress relaxation at 0.05, 0.10, 0.15 rad; shear stress/strain at sample periphery.
how_to_simulate: Model an 8 mm diameter, ~1.4 mm thick NP disc between impermeable platens with 10% axial compression
Apply sinusoidal torsion (0.01 rad) at 1, 10, 100 rad/s

extraction.check_notes: Table 2 from text layer (mean +- SD, n=13). Table 1 viscoelastic spectrum parameters are model fits - not extracted. Same laboratory as Iatridis 1997b (J Orthop Res); sample overlap not stated. doi not printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
